scientific_integrity: The proof separates the already known Wagner real-rooted-factor case from the three previously unhandled polygon-factor numerator cases. Exact symbolic computations prove finite polynomial coefficient identities, not infinite computational sampling. No absolute historical uniqueness claim.
scientific_limitations: Applies to full-dimensional Cartesian products of planar lattice polygons. Does not assert real-rootedness for general four-polytopes or higher-dimensional factors. Exact finite integer-discriminant certificates are reproduced with SymPy; independent expert validation is not performed. Older equivalent formulations may exist.
title: Real-rooted Ehrhart numerators for every product of two lattice polygons
